Check possible using Ka: pKa(NH4+) = 14 - pKb = 9.2553. pH = pKa + log([base]/[acid]) => 9 = 9.2553 + log ratio => log ratio = -0.2553 => ratio=0.56. So B.

由缓冲溶液公式：

\[
\text{pH}=\text{p}K_a+\lg\frac{c(\text{NH}_3\cdot H_2O)}{c(\text{NH}_4^+)}
\]

其中：

\[
\text{p}K_a=14-\text{p}K_b=14-[-\lg(1.8\times10^{-5})]=14-4.74=9.26
\]

代入 \(\text{pH}=9.00\)：

\[
9.00=9.26+\lg\frac{c(\text{NH}_3\cdot H_2O)}{c(\text{NH}_4Cl)}
\]

\[
\lg\frac{c(\text{NH}_3\cdot H_2O)}{c(\text{NH}_4Cl)}=-0.26
\]

\[
\frac{c(\text{NH}_3\cdot H_2O)}{c(\text{NH}_4Cl)}\approx 0.56
\]

答案：B
